name: sjskills-maintenance
description: Automatic published-main hook updates, stable sjskills CLI updates, and reviewed skill synchronization at session startup.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the hook, sjskills CLI, and configured skills current.
interface.longDescription: On new and resumed sessions, the agent checks this plugin for published main updates daily, updates the stable sjskills CLI, and reviews and synchronizes configured global and project skills.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my sjskills maintenance plugin, CLI, and configured skills.
